prompt: Compute the 6x6 transfer matrices for a drift (L=2 m), a focusing quadrupole (L=0.5 m, K1=1.5 m⁻²), and a sector dipole (L=1 m, angle=0.2 rad). For each element verify key matrix entries against the analytic formula: drift M[0,1]=L, quad trace_x = 2·cos(√K1·L), dipole dispersion M[0,5] nonzero. Report trace_x, trace_y, D_exit, and T56 for each element.

Design a periodic FODO cell for a 3 GeV electron ring: total cell length 10 m, two 9° sector dipoles, one focusing and one defocusing quadrupole, drift spaces. Find the quadrupole strength that gives a horizontal phase advance of 60° per cell. Report trace_x, trace_y, phase_advance_x_deg, D_exit, and T56.

Design a 3 GeV electron storage ring with a FODO lattice: 20 cells, 2 dipoles per cell, circumference around 100 m. Compute the fractional tunes, natural chromaticities, natural emittance, momentum compaction factor, radiation integrals I1–I5, damping partition numbers (Robinson sum), energy loss per turn U0, and damping times. Also report the peak beta functions and peak dispersion, and explain where to place BPMs and orbit correctors for best orbit response.

Design a 6 GeV 7-bend achromat storage ring with 24 superperiods. Use a mirror-symmetric cell with graded dipoles and 7 quadrupole families. Compute the radiation integrals I1–I5, natural horizontal emittance, damping partition numbers (the Robinson sum Jx+Jy+Je should equal 4), energy loss per turn, and damping times.

Design a 3 GeV double-bend achromat storage ring with 12 cells and circumference around 250 m. Target natural horizontal emittance below 5 nm·rad. Report tunes, chromaticities, emittance, and radiation integrals.

Design a 2.5 GeV FODO booster ring with 20 cells and circumference around 160 m, with one focusing and one defocusing quadrupole per cell. Report tunes, chromaticities, emittance, and momentum compaction factor.

Design a 6 GeV 7BA storage ring for a fourth-generation synchrotron light source with 24 superperiods and target natural emittance below 50 pm·rad. Report tunes, chromaticities, emittance, radiation integrals, and damping times.
Design a 0.5 GeV DBA storage ring with 4 cells, circumference 20 m, target emittance below 1 pm·rad, no sextupoles, and large dynamic aperture.

MBA STAGE 1: Define the design contract for a 6 GeV 7-bend achromat storage ring with 24 superperiods targeting emittance below 50 pm-rad and circumference around 500 m. List hard constraints and ranked goals. Use estimate_mba_emittance and check_design_feasibility tools.

MBA STAGE 2: Decompose one superperiod of a 24-cell 7BA ring into: StraightMatcher + DSC + N x UnitCell + mirror DSC + StraightMatcher. Use the decompose_superperiod tool. Report the number of unit cells per period.

MBA STAGE 3: Build the generic symmetric unit cell for a 7BA using build_unit_cell_topology. Identify quadrupole families, sextupole positions (SF near outer symmetry, SD near main bends), and the mirror axis.

MBA STAGE 4: Compute all valid Higher-Order-Achromat phase advances for a 24-superperiod 7BA ring (168 total dipoles) using compute_hoa_phase_advance. Report valid (Nx, Ny) pairs, per-dipole phase advances, and flag resonance warnings.

MBA STAGE 5: Using the 7BA unit cell topology and HOA phase advance target (~55 deg/dipole X, ~30 deg/dipole Y), write a pyJuTrack script that optimizes 7 quadrupole K1 values to achieve the target phase advance while keeping the cell achromatic (D_exit ~ 0, Dp_exit ~ 0). Scan reverse-bend fraction (0%, 2%, 5% of total bend). Report trace_x, trace_y, D_exit, Dp_exit, and mu_x/mu_y for the best configuration.

MBA STAGE 6: For a 7BA unit cell at 6 GeV, place chromatic sextupoles using compute_correction_leverage. Assume SF positions have beta_x~15m, beta_y~5m, Dx~0.3m. SD positions have beta_x~5m, beta_y~10m, Dx~0.2m. Report leverage_x, leverage_y, is_effective, and recommended K2 range for each position.

MBA STAGE 7: Construct a Dispersion Suppression Cell that matches typical 7BA unit cell exit Twiss (beta_x~12m, alpha_x~0.2, beta_y~5m, alpha_y~0.1, Dx~0.25m, Dpx~-0.01) to a zero-dispersion straight (Dx=0, Dpx=0, beta_x~10m, beta_y~3m). Use check_dsc_matching_conditions. Report required quadrupole families and feasibility.

MBA STAGE 8: Match a straight section (4 quadrupoles, 5 m length) to connect the DSC exit to the unit cell entrance. Target beta_x=10m, beta_y=3m, alpha_x=0, alpha_y=0, Dx=0 at straight centre. Write a pyJuTrack script using EdwardsTengTwiss + twissline.

MBA STAGE 9: Assemble a 6 GeV 7BA ring with 24 superperiods. Use the std7ba_6gev template topology. Verify: total bend=2*pi, tunes away from integer/half-integer, Robinson sum Jx+Jy+Je=4.0 +/- 0.05, U0 from analytical formula, emittance below 100 pm-rad.

MBA STAGE 10: For the 6 GeV 7BA ring from stage 9, perform a nonlinear readiness check: compute quick on-momentum DA estimate (6 angles x 512 turns), check dipole field < 1.8 T, quad gradient < 50 T/m, sextupole |k2| < 500 m^-3. Report DA area estimate in mm^2.

VALIDATE an MBA lattice design: verify the Robinson sum is 4.0 +/- 0.01, U0 matches analytical formula within 5%, natural chromaticities are correctable with |k2| < 500 m^-3, and emittance is within 5x the theoretical TME floor for 7BA at 6 GeV/24 cells (TME floor ~24 pm-rad).

MBA HOA ENFORCEMENT: Verify that a 168-dipole (24 cells x 7 bends) MBA ring has tune values consistent with the HOA condition n*mu/(2*pi) = integer. The ring tune should NOT be a random fractional value — it must come from the discrete HOA set. Use compute_hoa_phase_advance to enumerate valid options and check the working point against them.
